title: helmia brachycarpa
intro: Helmia brachycarpa, commonly known as the Helichrysum brachycarpum, is a plant species in the daisy family Asteraceae. It is a shrub-like herb native to South Africa, known for its medicinal properties and traditional uses. The health benefits of Helichrysum brachycarpum include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to alleviate symptoms of arthritis, improve wound healing, and protect against cell damage. The plant's bioactive constituents include sesquiterpene lactones, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and anti-cancer properties.
